# Muhammed Rifad KP (Rifad)

> Muhammed Rifad KP is a full-stack web developer based in Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India. He builds websites, online stores and web apps for businesses in the United Arab Emirates and India, using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and MongoDB. This is his portfolio: https://www.rifad.site

## Key facts

- Name: Muhammed Rifad KP (also known as Rifad)
- Role: Freelance full-stack web developer and IT teacher
- Location: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India. Works remotely with clients in the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) and across India
- Education: Bachelor of Computer Applications, Yenepoya University, Mangaluru (2021 to 2024)
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +91 73568 52496, email muhammedrifadkp3@gmail.com

## Services

- Business websites: Fast, search-ready sites for clinics, agencies, real estate and service companies, with enquiries going to WhatsApp or email.
- Online stores: Catalogues, filters, carts and checkout, from a small shop to a store with a custom product finder.
- Web apps: Logins, roles, dashboards and APIs on React, Node.js and MongoDB, like the attendance system running at an institute today.
- 3D on the web: Interactive models and scroll scenes in Three.js, like the workstation and the flight on this page.

## How a project goes

1. You tell me what you need. Send a message on WhatsApp or by email. We have a short call, and I come back with a plan and a price before any work starts.
2. I design it around your customers. Pages, wording and layout are planned for the people who will use the site, and for a phone screen first.
3. I build it where you can see it. You get a preview link while I build, so you watch the site take shape and can ask for changes while they are still easy.
4. It goes live, and I stay. I connect your domain, set the site up for Google and hand it over. Updates, fixes and new pages are covered after launch.

## Questions and answers

### What do you build?
Business websites, online stores and web apps, front end to database. If you need 3D or motion on the page, that too.

### Do you work with local businesses in Kozhikode (Calicut)?
Yes. As a freelance web developer in Kozhikode (Calicut), I build websites, e-commerce stores and booking apps for clinics, shops, institutes and service businesses across Kerala, and we can meet locally or over WhatsApp and calls.

### How long does a project take?
Most websites take two to four weeks. Larger apps take one to three months, depending on what they have to do.

### Do you look after the site after launch?
Yes. I offer ongoing maintenance and support, so updates, fixes and new pages are covered.

### What does a website cost?
Every project is priced on what it has to do. Tell me the pages and features you need, and I send a plan with a price before any work starts.

### Which technologies do you use?
Next.js and React on the front end, Node.js, Express and MongoDB on the back end, Tailwind CSS for styling and Vercel for hosting. For stores I also work with Shopify.

### Where are you based, and who do you work with?
I am based in Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India, and work with businesses in Kozhikode, across Kerala, India and the UAE (Dubai and Abu Dhabi). Everything happens smoothly over WhatsApp, email, calls or local meetings.

### How do we start?
Send a message on WhatsApp or by email with what you have in mind. We set up a short call and I come back with a plan and a price.

- Freelance full-stack developer, Clients in the UAE and India (2023 – now): Sites and stores for businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and India: AG Star’s Bike Finder, ZHM’s property portal, Ad Firms’ setup packages, and the CDC attendance system.
- Full-stack developer, Zuditt AI (6 months): Built React and Next.js dashboards and wired AI services into the product through secure REST APIs.
- Full-stack instructor, CADD Centre, Kasaragod (1 year): Taught HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js and MongoDB, and saw students through their capstone builds.
- IT lab teacher, Sirajul Huda (Now): I write and teach the IT syllabus from Plus One to PG, and publish it as its own site.

### Midhula Farm Hut
- Type: Ornamental fish farm, Thrissur

- Context: Midhula Farm Hut breeds guppies, bettas, shrimp, aquatic plants and live moina in Nooluvally, Thrissur, and ships them oxygen-packed across India. Most of its buyers find it on YouTube and Instagram and used to order through WhatsApp catalogues.
- What Rifad built: I built a fast Vite site with a real-time 3D betta in the hero, the farm’s 53 varieties with real prices, and a tank builder that turns the chosen fish into a ready WhatsApp order. The copy is in English and Malayalam.
- Highlights: Swimming 3D betta in the hero; Real prices for 53 varieties; Order built straight into WhatsApp; English and Malayalam
- Built with: Vite, JavaScript, Three.js, WhatsApp

### Burj Holidays
- Type: Travel agency, Thrissur
- What it is: A redesign for a Thrissur travel agency: tour packages, visa services and flight tickets, with every page leading to a WhatsApp enquiry.
- Context: Burj Holidays is a travel agency in West Fort, Thrissur, selling tour packages to Malaysia, Thailand, Dubai, Kashmir, Europe and more, plus visa services. Its old WordPress site did not show what it sells or make it easy to ask for a trip.
- What Rifad built: I rebuilt it in Astro with a page for each destination package, separate visa, flight and group tour pages, and a “Plan your journey” enquiry on WhatsApp. Each page is static HTML set up for local search in Thrissur.
- Highlights: Page for every tour package; Visa, flight and group tour pages; WhatsApp trip enquiry; Local SEO for Thrissur
- Built with: Astro, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Pages, SEO

### Ramseena & Mansoor
- Type: Wedding invitation website
- What it is: A wedding invitation that opens like an envelope, with the Nikah details, venue map and RSVP, shared as one link on WhatsApp.
- Context: Ramseena and Mansoor wanted an invitation guests could open from a WhatsApp message, with the date, time and venue in one place.
- What Rifad built: I built a Next.js invitation that opens from a sealed envelope, then shows the couple, the Nikah and reception details, a Google Maps link to the venue and an RSVP form. RSVPs go to a Google Sheet the family can check, and the link shows a proper preview card on WhatsApp.
- Highlights: Opens from an envelope; RSVP saved to Google Sheets; Venue on Google Maps; WhatsApp preview card
- Built with: Next.js, TypeScript, Google Sheets
- Live site: https://ramseena-wedding.vercel.app/

### MSF Theekkuni
- Type: Event registration and delegate pass
- What it is: Registration for a student conference in Malayalam: delegates sign up and download a pass with their own ID and QR code.
- Context: MSF Theekkuni Shakha needed delegates to register for its conference from their phones and get a pass, and organisers needed one list of everyone who signed up.
- What Rifad built: I built a mobile-first registration site in Malayalam with a countdown to the event. Each delegate gets a downloadable pass with a registration ID and QR code, saved to Firebase, and organisers search, filter and export the list to Excel from an admin page.
- Highlights: Pass with ID and QR code; Admin list with Excel export; Malayalam, mobile first; Countdown to the event
- Built with: Vite, JavaScript, Firebase, QR codes
- Live site: https://msftheekkuni.vercel.app/

### CDC Attendance

### Pontis Energy Dealer App
- Type: Dealer app for a solar company
- What it is: Solar dealers fill in a checked form for each customer, add GPS-stamped site photos and send it all to the office as one PDF.
- Context: Pontis Energy’s dealers collect customer details, ID numbers, panel serials and rooftop photos for every solar install. The office was getting this as loose WhatsApp messages and typing it into spreadsheets.
- What Rifad built: I built an installable app on Cloudflare Pages. Dealers log in, fill a form that checks mobile, Aadhaar and PAN numbers and catches duplicate panel serials, and add photos stamped with their GPS location. The app makes one PDF on the phone, and the office turns received PDFs back into an Excel list. Customer details stay on the dealer’s phone and are never stored on the server.
- Highlights: Checked forms (Aadhaar, PAN, mobile); GPS-stamped site photos; One PDF per customer; Office turns PDFs into Excel
- Built with: JavaScript, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1, PWA
- Live site: https://pontis-dealer.pages.dev/
- Case page: https://www.rifad.site/projects/pontis-dealer

- Case page: https://www.rifad.site/projects/zuditt

### FreshMarket
- Type: Grocery store with admin panel
- What it is: A MERN shop with accounts, an admin panel and orders sent straight to WhatsApp.
- Highlights: Cart saved in the database; WhatsApp order dispatch; Admin portal
- Built with: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- Live site: https://my-ecommerce-black.vercel.app/
- Case page: https://www.rifad.site/projects/freshmarket

### Nasiha Sara
- Type: Portfolio for an architectural designer
- What it is: A portfolio for an architectural designer and 3D visualiser, with her projects and a CV to download.

- Built with: React, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- Live site: https://nasiha-arc.vercel.app

### Rainforest
- Type: 2D platformer game
- What it is: A browser platformer on HTML5 canvas with its own game loop and collision physics.
- Highlights: Game loop; Collision detection; Keyboard controls
- Built with: Canvas, JavaScript
- Live site: https://rain-forest.vercel.app
- Case page: https://www.rifad.site/projects/rainforest
